Hollow Reign Privacy Policy (DRAFT)

Draft only; not legal advice. Have it reviewed before publishing. Host it at a public URL for App Store Connect.

Effective date: TODO

Summary
Hollow Reign does not collect, store on a server, share, or sell any personal data.

What we do not do
•  No accounts or sign-in
•  No analytics or crash-reporting services
•  No advertising and no ad or tracking SDKs
•  No in-app purchases
•  No network connection is required to play

What stays on your device
Game progress, settings, and saved data are stored locally on your device. We cannot see them. Deleting the app removes them. If you use iCloud or device backups, your device settings govern whether the save file is included, and we do not access it.

Children
The game contains fantasy violence and carries an age rating chosen in the App Store (expected 13+). We do not knowingly collect data from anyone, including children.

Credits and licences

Everything shipped in the game is either original to this project or under a licence that allows commercial distribution.

Game code, data, design, writing: This project. Proprietary (yours)
Character concept art (art/concept/): Generated with Higgsfield (GPT Image 2.6) from prompts in tools/concepts.py. Generated for this project; check Higgsfield's terms for commercial use on your plan
Character models (assets/models/*.glb): Generated and rigged with Tripo from those concepts (tools/tripo.py). Generated for this project; check Tripo's terms for commercial use on your plan
Weapons, dragons, environments: Built in code at runtime (src/chars/, src/world/arena.gd). Original
Textures: Generated at runtime from noise (src/world/look.gd). Original
All sound effects, ambience and music: Synthesized by tools/gen_audio.py (no samples). Original
App icon: Drawn by script. Original
Cinzel typeface: Natanael Gama, via @fontsource/cinzel. SIL Open Font License 1.1 (assets/fonts/LICENSE-Cinzel-OFL.txt)
EB Garamond typeface: Georg Duffner and Octavio Pardo, via @fontsource/eb-garamond. SIL Open Font License 1.1 (assets/fonts/LICENSE-EBGaramond-OFL.txt)
Godot Engine 4.6: godotengine.org. MIT. The engine's licence text and third-party notices must be reproduced in the shipped app (add a "Licences" screen before release).

No assets, names, characters, text, music or code were taken from Infinity Blade, Dark Souls, Elden Ring or any other game. The four reference images supplied with the brief were used as mood reference only and are not in the repository.

Higgsfield and Tripo were connected on 2026-11-25. No reference image from any other game was given to either service; all prompts are text descriptions of original designs.
